Terran Partition v2.01

Patch Notes:

Fixed:
[olist]
[*]Missiles not detonating if aimed at target area

notes.title: Roguelite ABMS Mode Upgraded, Terran Partition v2.00
notes.content:
Slizer Battle Management System: Terran Partition just released version 2.00 (not that anyone would know unless they checked the file version since I haven't been putting out patch notes).

This marks the end of the planned new features added to ABMS mode. I may add more features if there is interest shown.

SBMS updates:
[list]
[*] Secret cheat code added to kill all enemies
[*] "Live" mission fixed crashing and fixed game ending sequence not activating
[*] Enemy Venator fixed crashing
[*] •Revenant and Maris Stellaris ships fixed not having their abilities displayed in menus
[/list]

ABMS updates:
[list]
[*] Boss fleets added when all other units are killed
[*] Log in menu improved visuals
[*] ABMS ending sequence added
[*] Enemy spawns improved to not be as close
[*] All units except the Buster are now available to build
[*] Fixed new
[/list] games using the last loaded game data

Honestly the only reason I added the cheat code was to make testing easier, which I should have done years ago because it's saved me a ton of time and effort.

I never really gave much thought to improving ABMS mode, especially not this much. IT was asked for and it was a lot of work getting it updated and working, but it's actually sort of nice. I hated working on it but once it started to work well, I got that programmer's delight of seeing the thing that had become known as a dysfunctional mess suddenly and unexpectedly working reliably. It's still a bit of a mess but it's functional. And it's kind of fun, but Wraiths are overpowered. I'll have to copy the changes over to BMS2 when I can.

I think this screenshot is from version 1.98. I should probably remove all that text which was only there for me to test things, but some of it actually sort of gives it character? I'll probably remove it. Also not sure what to do with cloak/speed, linear/circular scans and a few other things, but I don't like to make changes to things that aren't a problem.

I hope everyone enjoys it, and please report any issues on Steam or via e-mail.

notes.title: ABMS Roguelite: Added Fleets, User List, KIA
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The roguelite "ABMS" mode in Terran Partition now has enemy Groups, which have destroyers and battlecruisers in them; Flotillas with only battlecruisers; and Fleets with any array of units. These increase the total enemy count to 40.

[*] While it's currently ugly, I changed the ABMS user buttons to a list so that any number of users profiles can be accessed.

[*] Users that are defeated now cannot access that profile anymore as they are properly marked as KIA.

[*] I've temporarily removed enemies taking over player bases because it caused the player to get stuck in a constant loop of replaying the same battle when they tried to take the base back. I spent all of today trying to fix it but can't find the cause, especially since this problem doesn't happen when the player conquers an enemy base.
[/list]

Next patch will space out enemies better, fix the enemy base takeover issue, and fix the menu. Final boss will come at some point after that.

I'm not sure if user ranks are working, I didn't rank up while testing at all.

notes.title: Terran Partition is Now Released!
notes.content:
Terran Partition, the standalone expansion to Slizer Battle Management System is now available on Steam.

It has massive improvements to gameplay, controls, GUI, and graphics. [b]You do not need to play SBMS to play this expansion.[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] Abilities have been reworked to be easier to aim and have more tactical depth. Airmechs have launch timers and limited repairs. Laser cannons now target the exact location instead of the direction cast. The damage system has been reworked, with a new variable: weapon pressure. Unit ranges have been significantly increased.
[*] [b]Story:[/b] The original story is included with new missions, an improved learning curve, and new content. The story is continued from the original 22 missions to 57 total.
[*] [b]Controls:[/b] Controls have been improved for unit orders, abilities, and the menus. Optional buttons are now available in-game if you would rather use the mouse.
[*] [b]Graphics:[/b] All in-game colours are now customisable, menus have been made simpler and more intuitive.
[/list]

notes.title: SBMS v1.19b11 Released
notes.content:
Version v1.19b11 has been released. Patch highlights are:

[list]
    [*]All missions previously removed have been re-inserted. The original campaign (missions 21-44) will cause the game to crash because I need to add a workaround to make them compatible with the new mission briefing system.
    [*]Bug fixes
    [*]Biofuel file added to the Technology section of the Library
[/list]

http://www.indiedb.com/games/slizer-strategy/news/sbms-v119-updates/

To complete the game for full release, I'll be adding some missions and making them functional / better. Along with the full release will be the expansion, ABMS, which has many major changes, and most importantly looks prettier. I'm planning to release this as $5 paid DLC. It has all the features of SBMS plus new units, updates abilities to increase tactical use, damage system has been redone to include the "pressure" variable vs armor, damage drop goes to 0 damage at max range with weapon ranges vastly increased, and finally when complete it will have a different campaign. If you're wondering why I didn't make these changes in this version, it's because they make stylistic changes which I feel make it too different from how it originally was played.

This version of SBMS will be to get feedback on the added missions so I can improve them before full release.
